races.race_name: JenningsBet Over 200 Shops Nationwide Handicap

runners.name: Havana Jag
runners.spotlight: Consistent maiden who has made the frame from off the pace on all three starts for her new stable this summer (5f-6f, good to firm); remains on the same mark; probably on the premises again.
runners.comment: Consistent maiden who has made the frame on all three starts for new stable this summer

runners.name: Mister Moet
runners.spotlight: Gave good account when fourth over 7f on Tapeta a fortnight ago and is now 1lb lower than for 5f Polytrack win in March; 6f on fast turf should also suit; no surprise if he features.
runners.comment: Drops back in trip after good 7f AW run last month; no surprise if he features

runners.name: Cape Toronada
runners.spotlight: Off the mark with clearcut C&D (good) success in June and didn't really enjoy the run of the race when fourth behind heavily backed stablemate at Windsor (6f, good to firm) a fortnight later; sure to be suited by return to this track and may still have a bigger run in her.
runners.comment: Clearcut C&D winner in June; didn't run badly last time; may still have more to offer

runners.name: Beach Partee
runners.spotlight: Won three times (once over C&D) for another stable as a 2yo; yet to hit top gear for current trainer (eight runs since April) but recent efforts have been respectable and he continues to edge down the weights.
runners.comment: Operating below best 2yo form but recent efforts have been respectable

runners.name: Love Alive
runners.spotlight: Generally disappointing since opening account at Wolverhampton (5f, AW) in February but kept on for third off reduced mark on recent stable debut at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) and drops in grade here; respected.
runners.comment: Kept on for third on recent stable debut at Thirsk; drops in grade here; respected

races.race_name: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes

runners.name: Rovinia
runners.spotlight: Yet fully to convince stamina-wise over 1m but came second in this grade at Lingfield (7.6f/7f, good to firm) on her last two outings and features prominently in calculations.
runners.comment: Second in this grade at Lingfield (7.6f/7f) on last time outings; high on the list

runners.name: River Wharfe
runners.spotlight: Gained five of his 11 wins at this track; not at best in three handicaps since returned to turf in June but was only beaten about 2l when fifth of seven at Windsor (1m, good to firm) last time and is strong interest in this lower grade and with cheekpieces refitted.
runners.comment: Five course wins; not at best lately but of strong interest back in this grade

runners.name: First Encounter
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner (8.4f/1m) in this grade at start of this year; ran as though something was amiss when back on turf last month but has possibilities if back on song.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner in this grade this year; ran poorly on turf last month but still considered

runners.name: Rainbow Sign
runners.spotlight: Narrow winner of C&D (good to firm) handicap in September and went close in this grade here (7f, good) in June; safely held on AW at Lingfield since but was poorly positioned on outside of the field there and can do better here.
runners.comment: C&D winner in September, and went close in this grade here (7f) in June; shortlisted

runners.name: Skyolaire
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all seven starts; ran quite well when sixth of 13 in Bath handicap (1m2f, good; first-time cheekpieces) in June but was soundly beaten in 7f classified here (good to firm) later that month; needs to find extra.
runners.comment: Ran okay in a handicap two starts ago but is yet to be placed after seven starts

runners.name: Celebrating Ethel
runners.spotlight: Won in this grade at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in March and is also suited by this track but her recent handicap form has been disappointing; tried in a visor on latest outing; cheekpieces are refitted today.
runners.comment: Won in this grade on AW in March but recent handicap form has been disappointing

runners.name: Sangara
runners.spotlight: 0-9 when trained by Jack Channon; placed in Pontefract handicap (1m2f, good to soft) in September but absent since heavy defeat on AW in October; usual tongue-tie left off for this seasonal/stable debut.
runners.comment: Placed in a handicap in September but absent since heavy defeat in October; stable debut

runners.name: Aspire To Glory
runners.spotlight: Six-time AW winner for Alice Haynes; well below best form for new stable this year but his two recent turf runs in this grade (1m/7f, good to firm) were fairly respectable, and he might be boosted by the refitted blinkers here.
runners.comment: Well below best this season but recent efforts in this grade were fairly respectable

runners.name: Rock Master
runners.spotlight: 20-race maiden who returned from a break with two disappointing runs this summer (1m/7f), the latter in this grade in refitted cheekpieces; not yet proven over 1m; others have much stronger claims.
runners.comment: 20-race maiden who returned from a break with two disappointing runs this summer

races.race_name: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)

runners.name: Northern Empire
runners.spotlight: Won 7f AW novice in January; returned from break with three poor handicap runs in the spring but, having been gelded, his keeping-on fifth at Epsom (7f, good) last month was much more encouraging; still unexposed over 1m; interesting.
runners.comment: Gelded in June and subsequent run suggested he's getting his career back on track

runners.name: Silca Bay
runners.spotlight: Showed career-best form when leading close home at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) last month and has now won under Oliver Carmichael on two of his last three outings; ought to cope with the undulations here and can make his presence felt again.
runners.comment: Showed career-best form when leading close home at Newmarket (1m) last month; respected

runners.name: Play Me
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent 4yo who came from off the pace to score over C&D (good) in June; below form at Epsom since, though, and probably doesn't have much margin for error off current mark.
runners.comment: C&D winner in June but below form last time and still on fairly tough mark
runners.owner: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner

runners.name: Giant
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner who has made the frame four times on turf this summer (6f-7.6f); disappointed on latest outing, having been restless in the stalls, but his current mark is workable and he'll be fine over today's trip.
runners.comment: Three-time AW winner who has made the frame four times on turf this summer; a possible

runners.name: Tex
runners.spotlight: Belatedly came good with clearcut Ascot win (7f, good to firm) last month, his 12th start, and was not discredited when ninth in big-field sprint at Glorious Goodwood a week ago; will be suited by this return to 1m and may still have a bit more to offer.
runners.comment: Good 7f winner last month and not discredited in recent Glorious Goodwood sprint

runners.name: Glen Nevis
runners.spotlight: Managed only ninth of 11 on last month's handicap debut at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) but was placed in two of his three qualifying races (7f/7.4f) and could still have significant potential.
runners.comment: Only ninth of 11 on last month's handicap debut but could still have potential
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Newfangled
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D (good to firm) in September and was also on target at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in April; recent efforts have been respectable and he holds each-way claims at least.
runners.comment: C&D winner in September; recent efforts have been respectable; each-way claims at least

runners.name: Sea Suite
runners.spotlight: Dual 7f winner this season; looked as good as ever when clear second to progressive rival at Sandown (1m, good to firm) 12 days ago but recent 4lb rise demands a bit more from him here.
runners.comment: Dual 7f winner this year; clear second over 1m recently but raised another 4lb for that

runners.name: Here I Bow
runners.spotlight: Ex-French filly who was safely held on both British starts this spring (7f/1m) and needs subsequent wind surgery to have made a big difference.
runners.comment: Safely held on both British starts; needs subsequent wind op to have made a difference

races.race_name: Monty Bennetts 18th Birthday Handicap

runners.name: Buckland Belle
runners.spotlight: Took form to new level when scoring at Leicester (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago, her second success this season; 6lb higher here but could have untapped potential over this new trip; must be considered.
runners.comment: Career-best form when scoring over 1m last month; might improve again over this new trip

runners.name: Port Darwin
runners.spotlight: Slightly disappointing on both starts since emphatic success at Hamilton (1m1f, good to soft) in June and still needs to prove he's effective on fast ground but his current mark is workable and he can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Shade disappointing on both starts since convincing win in June but can't be ruled out

runners.name: Annexation
runners.spotlight: Long in the tooth now and not firing on all cylinders this season but, from a reduced mark, ran well in defeat over C&D (good to firm) in June; had excuse (lame) when below form here last month; big player if all goes to plan this time.
runners.comment: Ran well in defeat over C&D in June and had excuse (lame) for last month's lesser effort

runners.name: Beryl's Girl
runners.spotlight: Benefited from combination of step up in trip and first-time cheekpieces when making all over C&D (good to firm) in June, her seventh start; open to further progress but needs to bounce back from a disappointing effort at Leicester last month.
runners.comment: Made all over C&D when upped in trip in June; needs to bounce back from a lesser run since

runners.name: It's Life
runners.spotlight: Far too inconsistent to rely upon heavily but just did enough to cause 22-1 surprise on recent seasonal debut at Salisbury (1m, good to firm; front pair clear), and could be seen to even better effect now back up in trip.
runners.comment: Surprise 1m winner on recent seasonal debut; this longer trip ought to suit her better

runners.name: West Hill Rosie
runners.spotlight: Unexposed after only five runs (one in a bumper) but was unable to land a significant blow when well-held third of four over C&D (good to firm) on handicap debut in June; improvement required.
runners.comment: Still unexposed, but was unable to land a significant blow over C&D on handicap debut

races.race_name: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)

runners.name: Havana Mojito
runners.spotlight: Three-time course winner who has finished second four consecutive (twice over C&D on good to firm) since swapping cheekpieces for blinkers in May; likely to be right in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: Second four consecutive times (twice over C&D) since headgear change in May; big player

runners.name: Berning Hot
runners.spotlight: Placed twice on Polytrack this year (1m/7f); safely held on both starts since returned to turf but this is easier than the Sandown race she contested last month, and she's now 2lb lower than for last summer's C&D win; worth a second look.
runners.comment: Needs to better recent efforts but won over C&D last summer; worth a second look

runners.name: Quite Sweet
runners.spotlight: Came good at Southwell (1m, AW) in October, his second handicap, but has gone the wrong way since; in rear throughout at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) last month, after a break, and needs to have taken significant benefit from that outing.
runners.comment: Scored on AW in October but has gone the wrong way since; has a point to prove

runners.name: Viking Glory
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden; seemed to respond well to first-time visor when third of six at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) last month and should be fine over this extra furlong; now tries cheekpieces; enters calculations.
runners.comment: 0-8 but ran quite well in first-time visor last month (6f); now tries cheekpieces

runners.name: Miraflores
runners.spotlight: Well beaten at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and has now been unplaced all 14 starts; usual tongue-tie left off here; difficult to enthuse over.
runners.comment: Well beaten when back on turf last month and now 0-14; difficult to enthuse over

runners.name: Daley T
runners.spotlight: Close third in classified race here (5.2f, good; first-time cheekpieces) in June but was just a respectable fourth at Wolverhampton (5f, AW; first-time blinkers) last month and is now 0-26; needs to find something extra on this first venture beyond 6f.
runners.comment: Close third here (5.2f) in June but is 0-26; needs to find extra over this new trip

runners.name: Redredrobin
runners.spotlight: Eight-time winner; lurks on a dangerous mark and might be perked up by first-time cheekpieces but has looked out of sorts on all three starts since returning from a layoff in April; leap of faith required to support her.
runners.comment: Lurks on a dangerous mark and might be perked up by new headgear but has a lot to prove

runners.name: King Cherry
runners.spotlight: Raced far too freely in the lead before dropping out tamely on recent handicap debut at Sandown (7f, good to firm); remains unexposed after only four starts and is open to significant improvement if/when he learns to settle but comes with obvious risk attached.
runners.comment: Still unexposed but spoiled chance by racing far too freely on recent handicap debut

runners.name: The Organiser
runners.spotlight: Returned to turf with two decent efforts (both 7f, good) this spring, and his keeping-on fifth at Lingfield (7f, AW) last month was perfectly respectable; would appeal more on ground slower than good but still considered each-way.
runners.comment: Would appeal more on slow ground but recent efforts give him good each-way claims

races.race_name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Coast
runners.spotlight: Placed twice here this year (5.2f/6f) but ran poorly at Bath last month and it's now exactly two years since her last win; difficult to enthuse over.
runners.comment: Placed twice here this season but remains on a long losing run

runners.name: Faustus
runners.spotlight: Placed three times from seven starts since returned to turf in May; no match for easy winner when second over C&D (good to firm) last month and remains well below the best of last year's form but still has possibilities; often wears cheekpieces but goes in refitted blinkers today.
runners.comment: No match for easy winner when second here last month but still has possibilities

runners.name: Kento
runners.spotlight: Three wins this year, the latest by a nose over C&D (good to firm) in May; still in good form, albeit he was behind Faustus when third over C&D (good to firm; winner did it easily) last month; probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Narrow C&D winner in May and still in good form; probably won't be far away

runners.name: Secret Handsheikh
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with narrow win at Chepstow (5f, good to firm) in June; remains on workable mark after 3lb rise and is very well suited by this track (four-time C&D winner) but managed only fifth of six at Bath (5f, firm) three weeks ago and has become unreliable.
runners.comment: Four C&D wins; still on workable mark after Chepstow win in June but has become unreliable

runners.name: Titus Thor
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all seven starts; outran 50-1 odds when respectable fifth of 14 in Bath handicap (5f, good) in June and was denied clear run when filling same position in Chepstow classified (5f, good to firm) last month but others appeal more all the same.
runners.comment: 0-7; last couple of efforts offer some hope; others appeal more all the same

runners.name: Pop Dancer
runners.spotlight: Three-time C&D winner, most recently last May; absent since two disappointing runs here last August, though, and would appeal more on good or slower ground.
runners.comment: Three-time C&D winner; absent since two disappointing runs here last August, though

races.race_name: Honda Wakefield Super-N Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Star Start
runners.spotlight: Held up when winning this last year (good to firm) off 4lb higher mark; returns in good form after being placed twice at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) on his last two starts; major contender.
runners.comment: 4lb lower than when winning this last year; in good form and can again go close.

runners.name: Glitter Code
runners.spotlight: 22-race maiden (placed at up to 11.5f) whose better efforts over the past 12 months would give him each-way claims; needs to bounce back after a couple of below-par AW efforts.
runners.comment: 0-22; better efforts would give him each-way claims but has been below par on AW.

runners.name: The Pug
runners.spotlight: 1m2f turf winner (good) who has won over 1m3f on AW; holds place claims if back to the form of his third at Chepstow (on stable debut) in June.
runners.comment: 1m2f turf winner; place claims if back to the form of his first start for this trainer.

runners.name: Anificas Beauty
runners.spotlight: 1m course winner (stays 1m3f) who won back-to-back starts at Beverley (both 8.5f, sound surface) in May/June; below par here (1m, good) on her penultimate start but posted a better effort at Redcar (1m1f, good to firm) latest; needs another step back in the right direction.
runners.comment: 1m course winner (stays 1m3f) who won at Beverley in May/June; unplaced since.

runners.name: Max Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Multiple hurdle winner over 2m-2m1f who is 1-6 on turf in this code (1m4f win on soft); below her best in both codes across her last two starts but if able to reproduce her Ripon effort from mid-June (1m4f, good) then she could come into this over a shorter trip but a much stiffer track.
runners.comment: 1m4f winner (soft); if in the form of her Ripon run in June she could come into this.
runners.owner: Mrs S D Pearson & Ollie Pears

runners.name: Sunny Orange
runners.spotlight: Appears to prefer Beverley to elsewhere, having secured four of his five wins there, at up to 8.5f; has been a close second and third over 1m2f there on his last two starts; big player if as effective here.
runners.comment: Beverley specialist; sees out this trip there and will be a big player if effective here.

runners.name: Quirke On Parole
runners.spotlight: 1-14 (win was over 1m2f, good to firm); yet to reproduce last year's better efforts in 2026 and finished last of nine on AW (1m4f) latest; more needed.
runners.comment: Yet to reproduce last year's better efforts; last of nine (1m4f, AW) latest; more needed.
runners.owner: A Quirke & Mrs G B Walford

races.race_name: Jayne - On Course Lady Bookmaker EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Rock Steady Beat
runners.spotlight: Not at his best at Redcar (5f, good) in June last time when making it 0-3; however, gelded since and he went close at Carlisle (5f, good to soft) two starts ago, having previously shown promise at York (6f, good); top trainer has won the last two runnings; leading claims on penultimate form.
runners.comment: Below par last time to make it 0-3, but gelded since and leading claims on earlier form

runners.name: Our Son Oscar
runners.spotlight: 78,000gns yearling, £65,000 2yo breeze-ups; second foal; dam once-raced half-sister to winners Find (Group-placed 6f/7f) and Third Kingdom (useful 7f/1m), out of US 8.5f 2yo Grade 1 winner; trainer is enjoying a good year with his 2yos and this Starman newcomer could be a contender.
runners.comment: Newcomer; £65,000 2yo breeze-ups; trainer is enjoying a good years with his 2yos

runners.name: Lady Henshaw
runners.spotlight: Beaten just over 5l when seventh of 11 on last month's debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm) but she was nibbled into 12-1 and there was some promise in that performance; this 90,000euros breeze-up buy has a useful pedigree and could be sharper for her debut experience; interesting contender.
runners.comment: Signs of promise when seventh on debut at Newbury and could be sharper for the experience

runners.name: Bugzy
runners.spotlight: By Advertise; second foal; dam unplaced 7f/1m (RPR 43), half-sister to 6f 2yo Listed winner Mild Illusion, out of unraced half-sister to useful 6f/7f winner Courageous; this Newmarket challenger makes his debut in a race lacking depth and could play a major role; watch the betting.
runners.comment: Newmarket challenger who makes his debut in a race lacking depth; could play major role

runners.name: Sankhum Galaxy
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam French 1m1f-1m4f winner, sister to winners Thunder Eclipse (useful 6f 2yo) and Eclipse Emerald (6f), family of outstanding Dubai Millennium; check the betting, but this Space Blues newcomer is likely to improve for the run.
runners.comment: Second foal; dam French 1m1f-1m4f winner; check betting, but likely to improve for the run

runners.name: Mubehir
runners.spotlight: 30,000gns 2yo breeze-ups; weakened quickly when tailed off at 33-1 on recent debut at Beverley (5f, good to firm); may be one for later on.
runners.comment: Weakened quickly when tailed off at 33-1 on recent debut at Beverley (5f, good to firm)

runners.name: Longshanks Luke
runners.spotlight: A market check is advised on this second start but he was always behind after a slow start at Catterick (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago, when sent off at 33-1 wearing blinkers (same today); transformation needed.
runners.comment: Always behind after a slow start at Catterick three weeks ago, when a 33-1 shot

runners.name: Chief Minister
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten at 40-1 on last month's debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm); however, this 55,000gns yearling has potential in his pedigree and this is an easier race than last time; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten at 40-1 on debut at Newbury but may be able to take sizeable step forward

races.race_name: Riu Hotels And Resorts Ladies Day Veterans' Handicap

runners.name: Garden Oasis
runners.spotlight: Prolific winning veteran, mostly over 1m on a sound surface; most recent success came in this race last year, when 8lb higher; supported when a close second at Ripon latest start; respected.
runners.comment: Won this last year when 8lb higher; close second at Ripon latest start; respected.

runners.name: Spirit Genie
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner at up to 8.5f on good or slower; on the slide in three starts this season but this combination of a drop in grade and new headgear may prompt a resurgence; return to shorter is also a plus; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Combination of a drop in grade and new headgear may prompt a resurgence.

runners.name: Soames Forsyte
runners.spotlight: Has had more AW than turf success; has gained both wins in this sphere at Nottingham (8.5f on good/good to soft); only midfield when returned to grass last time; others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: Has gained both turf wins at Nottingham; only midfield back in this sphere last time.

runners.name: Alessia Fernanda
runners.spotlight: Her wins have come on slow ground but she appears to act on good to firm; latest success came on AW (1m) in April, when 2lb lower; below that level in three turf starts since.
runners.comment: Below par in three starts since 1m AW win in April; appears to act on good to firm.

runners.name: Narmar
runners.spotlight: 1m winner (good and good to soft); on a handy mark if able to return to last season's form but has been well below that level this time; tongue-tie now accompanies usual cheekpieces; trainer also runs Spirit Genie.
runners.comment: 1m winner; on handy mark but has been well below par in three starts this season.

runners.name: Cosmos Raj
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner over 1m-1m2f; versatile regarding going; 12lb lower than his most recent win at Ripon 13 months ago; plenty to prove based on five of his six starts this season.
runners.comment: Multiple 1m-1m2f winner but plenty to prove based on five of his six starts this season.

races.race_name: FBS Chartered Accountants Chaplins Club Handicap

runners.name: Betweenthesticks
runners.spotlight: Won this last year and kicked off this campaign with two wins in a row, the second of them over C&D; he's run well in defeat over C&D on his last two starts and there's every chance he'll again be bang there.
runners.comment: Two-time C&D winner who has been in good form here of late and can be bang there
runners.owner: J A Swinburne & Mrs Ruth A Carr

runners.name: The Tunguska Event
runners.spotlight: Speedy 3yo who made all at Catterick (6f, good) in May; raced alone against the far rail when sixth of 12 at Newcastle (5f, AW) in June and shaped when fourth at Leicester (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago as though the return to 5f would be well worth a go; could make a bold bid.
runners.comment: Speedy 3yo for whom the return to 5f is well worth a go; could make a bold bid

runners.name: Bibendum
runners.spotlight: Having dropped back down to his last winning mark he won well at Leicester (5f, good to firm) in June, but had just two rivals to beat; only sixth at Beverley (5f, good to firm) since and he's never won off a mark this high.
runners.comment: Good win at Leicester in June but had just two to beat; only sixth at Beverley since

runners.name: Spirit Of Applause
runners.spotlight: Posted two good thirds at the start of last month (5f/5.6f, good to firm) before midfield finish in big-field Class 4 at York (6f, good to firm); the drop back in trip/grade can help and he could be in the mix.
runners.comment: In good form prior to lesser run at York but the drop back in trip/grade can help

runners.name: Sea Her Excel
runners.spotlight: Made all at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm) in June and bounced back from lesser run at Windsor to make all under Elle-May Croot at Ayr (5f, good to firm) last time; the widest draw may not be ideal but this in-form 3yo is still respected.
runners.comment: She's won two of her last three; drawn widest but this in-form 3yo is still respected

runners.name: Riffa Spirit
runners.spotlight: Up and down during this 3yo campaign but he was a good third at Musselburgh (5f, good) in April and would have been closer than sixth at Chester (5f, good) recently granted a clear run; could be involved.
runners.comment: 3yo who would have been closer than sixth at Chester last time granted a clear run

runners.name: Great
runners.spotlight: Got up late to win at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) last month; denied clear run when close fifth at Beverley (5f, good to firm) next time and kept on for third at Thirsk (6f, good) last Saturday; it's possible he'll get going too late back down to 5f but the stiff track and strong pace will help; chance.
runners.comment: Possible he'll get going too late back down to 5f but the stiff track will help; chance

runners.name: Missmimi
runners.spotlight: Absent since below-par run at Newcastle last November (wind op in interim); however, she won three times in the second half of last year, two of them here, and she ran well first time up last term; not discounted.
runners.comment: Returns from absence but won three times in the second half of last year; not discounted

runners.name: Sam's Xpress
runners.spotlight: 0-17 on turf as opposed to 7-26 on AW and unplaced on grass on his two starts this summer; however, he gave it a good go from the front at Chester (5f, good) last time when he used up lots of energy early from his wide draw, and he could be a serious force from the inside berth today.
runners.comment: 0-17 on turf but ran well for a long way from wide draw at Chester last time; interesting

runners.name: Le Beau Garcon
runners.spotlight: He's on a career-low mark but has finished down the field on his three starts since making an encouraging return to action at Ripon in May; needs to turn things around.
runners.comment: He's on a career-low mark but has finished down the field on his last three starts

races.race_name: Bet With Jayne - Your Local Bookmaker Handicap

runners.name: Alfa Whiteburd
runners.spotlight: Has won back-to-back starts at Chester (7f, good) and here over C&D (good to firm) under a penalty latest; up 7lb and in grade so this will be tougher but he enters calculations.
runners.comment: Back-to-back wins at Chester (7f) and over C&D; up 7lb and in grade; enters calculations.

runners.name: Emperor Caradoc
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner over 5f-7f, including here; versatile regarding ground; 1lb higher than latest win at Thirsk in May; matched that effort on his penultimate start but may find a couple too good on these terms.
runners.comment: Multiple 5f-7f winner, including here; may find a couple too good on these terms.

runners.name: Mister Sox
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; all wins on good or slower but acts on fast ground; 1l second from this mark at Thirsk last month but needs to shrug off two lesser efforts.
runners.comment: 1l second from this mark at Thirsk last month but needs to shrug off two lesser efforts.

runners.name: Willolarupi
runners.spotlight: 5f and 6f winner; returned from a break to finish 9l fourth behind Alfa Whiteburd over C&D recently; entitled to have needed that outing and drops 2lb but could have his work cut out in this line-up.
runners.comment: May have needed recent C&D reappearance but looks to have his work cut out in this field.

runners.name: Aberama Gold
runners.spotlight: Prolific winner, mainly over 6f, the latest when 2lb higher at Catterick (6f, good) in April; went close when on this mark in successive starts last month, before a below-par effort in a big-field York sprint latest; player if he can bounce back.
runners.comment: Prolific winner who retains ability; player if he can shrug off his latest York effort.

runners.name: Uppercase
runners.spotlight: Took eight starts to break his duck but he's now strung three improving efforts together, scoring at Catterick (7f, good to soft) and by over 3l at Epsom (7f, good to firm) latest; up 7lb; his prominent style of racing and the stiff track may enable him to cope with the drop to 6f; unexposed and interesting.
runners.comment: Improving, unexposed and interesting after a 7lb rise for his latest decisive Epsom win.

runners.name: The Good Biscuit
runners.spotlight: Goes well here and arrives seeking a hat-trick after wins at Catterick and over C&D (readily latest; both good to firm); carries penalty but on last week's evidence that may still not stop him.
runners.comment: Seeking hat-trick after a ready C&D win last week; penalty may not stop him.

runners.name: Mae Amor
runners.spotlight: Multiple 6f winner; inconsistent but back in better form when under 2l fourth at Goodwood (6f, good to firm) last week; same mark; enters calculations.
runners.comment: 6f winner; back in better form at Goodwood latest; same mark; enters calculations

runners.name: Sugar Baby
runners.spotlight: 5f and 6f winner, most recently in a 0-70 at Doncaster (good to firm) on his penultimate start; found out from this mark and in this grade in a big field at York latest; more needed.
runners.comment: Found out from this mark and in this grade in a big field at York latest; more needed.
runners.owner: Hard Held Partnership And Angus Racing

races.race_name: Napoleons Casino Bradford Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Something
runners.spotlight: Made all at Ripon (1m4f, good) in May on stable debut and he's been a good second on two of his three starts since (1m4f, good/good to firm), including here; didn't convince with his stamina for 2m back in January 2025 but a staying trip is worth another go and he's a major player if seeing it out.
runners.comment: In good form over 1m4f for new yard; major player if seeing out this longer trip

runners.name: Division Day
runners.spotlight: Won at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) in June when back from a break; unplaced at odds-on over hurdles next time and also below par when back on the Flat at York (2m, good to firm) most recently; however, the first-time cheekpieces could give him a lift and there can be optimism that this trip will be within range; trainer won this last year; in calculations.
runners.comment: Below best (hurdles/Flat) on last 2 runs but first-time cheekpieces could give him a lift

runners.name: Anzac Day
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced 5yo who has been unable to fulfil the significant promise shown when winning in 2023 on his second outing; however, he didn't run badly in fourth of five here (2m2f, good) in June on his second stable start and this is less competitive; could be a contender.
runners.comment: Didn't run badly here in June on second stable start and this is a drop in grade; possible

races.race_name: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race

runners.name: Concert Party
runners.spotlight: Two wins for Richard Hannon, both over 1m2f on easy ground; modest form so far over hurdles and on the Flat for this yard; soundly beaten in Ballinrobe claimer on latest; however, she met trouble in running and is probably capable of better.
runners.comment: Two wins in Britain last autumn, met trouble in running at Ballinrobe, capable of better

runners.name: Timandi
runners.spotlight: In good form lately in races in this category; won with plenty to spare over 1m4f at Tramore and then second to a well-fancied rival over 1m at Killarney; this trip should be fine.
runners.comment: In good form lately in races in this category over 1m4f and 1m, this trip should be fine
runners.owner: Mrs N K Griffin & T Brosnan

runners.name: Taj Crown
runners.spotlight: Second to useful yardstick Merlin The Giant in 1m4f optional claimer at Limerick in June; has obtained two more seconds since then, behind a much superior type in a maiden at Killarney and behind longer-priced stablemate at Ballinrobe; should not be far away.
runners.comment: Second to a longer-priced stablemate in a maiden last time, has run well in this category

runners.name: Miss Australie
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 15th attempt in a 1m4f Roscommon handicap last month (yielding-to-soft), coming from off the pace; down the field in two staying handicaps in June; this trip may prove inadequate.
runners.comment: Handicap winner over 1m4f at Roscommon three starts ago, this trip may be too sharp

runners.name: Capital Theory
runners.spotlight: Six wins in Britain; gained a first Irish success at Naas last October, scoring at 25-1 in a 16-runner handicap; previous form included a second placing in a Ballinrobe claimer, and sixth of 12 in the corresponding race to this; seasonal debut.
runners.comment: Six wins in Britain, gained a first Irish success at Naas last October, seasonal debut

runners.name: Chopsticks
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap over a longer trip at this venue last year; has a respectable record at Dundalk, placed seven times from 15 visits; below best there last month.
runners.comment: Won a handicap over a longer trip at this venue last year, below best on last two starts

runners.name: Dark Summit
runners.spotlight: Won over 1m in France last season; began this season with a handicap mark of 90 and was not out of his depth when eighth in the 25-runner Irish Lincoln; has slumped in the ratings after a series of poor displays; some signs of a revival at Galway last week; not ruled out now that he is dropped in grade.
runners.comment: Won in France, has slumped in the ratings, not ruled out now that he is dropped in grade

runners.name: Glittering Gem
runners.spotlight: Favourite for her debut in a 17-runner maiden at the Curragh last September, broke slowly, recovered to challenge before fading late; disappointed at Leopardstown in October when heavy ground may have been against her; has a bit to find with Taj Crown on running at Killarney, but less exposed than that rival.
runners.comment: Has a bit to find with Taj Crown on running at Killarney, less exposed than that rival

runners.name: Eastern Blue Bird
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form on the Flat and over hurdles; never in the first three; not one of the more appealing candidates.
runners.comment: Ordinary form on the Flat and over hurdles, not one of the more appealing candidates

runners.name: Avec Grand Plaisir
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form in maidens at around this trip; stayed on for third over 1m at Cork in June on his handicap debut; could be in the mix now.
runners.comment: Stayed on for third over 1m at Cork in June on his handicap debut, could be in the mix now

runners.name: Borora Aura
runners.spotlight: Weak overall form, and down the field in a handicap last time; however, she has reached the money in both outings in this grade, third at Ballinronbe in May and second at Fairyhouse last month.
runners.comment: Weak overall form but has reached the money in both outings in this grade

runners.name: Shemiyka
runners.spotlight: Ran twice for Dermot Weld late last season; showed winning potential when third behind two of the principal fancies in a 1m4f maiden at Galway last week; 100-1 then, entitled to be one of the market leaders now.
runners.comment: Showed winning potential when third in a 1m4f maiden at Galway, strong contender

runners.name: Shay's Dream
runners.spotlight: Stable in superb form; however, this one has shown next to nothing in maidens; may improve.
runners.comment: Stable in superb form but this one has shown next to nothing in maidens, may improve

runners.name: Mullacurry Maid
runners.spotlight: Some merit in her showing over 7f at Leopardstown on her fourth start in maidens; more recently, down the field at the same venue on handicap debut; unsuited by the race conditions; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, down the field on handicap debut, unsuited by the race conditions

runners.name: Princess Rosie
runners.spotlight: Weak form in maidens last season; 10l sixth of nine in a Fairyhouse race in this grade on final start; 10b claimer up for stable/ seasonal debut.
runners.comment: Weak form in maidens last season, 10l sixth of nine in a race in this grade on final start

runners.name: Money Shuffler
runners.spotlight: Weak form in bumpers and on AW at Dundalk; tailed off in a maiden hurdle on only outing this season; blinkered for the first time; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, weak form in bumpers and on AW at Dundalk, blinkered for the first time

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Connacht Oaks Fillies & Mares Handicap

runners.name: Spanish Temptress
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner at around 1m with ease in the ground on all occasions; handles good ground too and is also effective beyond a mile, as she showed when second in a fillies' handicap over an extended 1m3f at Killarney; has made the frame in all except one of her last seven starts.
runners.comment: Has shown her best form at around 1m on soft, also effective over further on good ground

runners.name: Thatwilldoso
runners.spotlight: Won narrowly at Roscommon in June and went very close to repeating last year's success in a 1m4f Galway handicap; due to go up 3lb for finishing a neck second; holds an obvious chance, providing this does not come too soon; last year's second in this event came after the same four-day interval.
runners.comment: Won at Roscommon in June, went very close at Galway on Saturday, holds an obvious chance

runners.name: Alice Monet
runners.spotlight: Won two small-field events last summer, a 1m2f claimer at Fairyhouse and a 1m1f handicap at Leopardstown; surpassed that form when a close fourth in the Listed 1m4f Galtres Stakes at York; never in a challenging position in a Listed race at Dundalk in September; absent since and may need this.
runners.comment: Ran in good company after winning two small-field events last year, lacks a recent outing

runners.name: Eastern Peace
runners.spotlight: Won a Dundalk maiden over a similar trip to this last November; best run since was when third in a 1m2f handicap at Leopardstown; 5lb out of the handicap here; tough task, rider's claim an asset.
runners.comment: Dundalk maiden winner, 5lb out of the handicap here, tough task, rider's claim an asset
runners.owner: Martin W Walsh & Tony Carey & Brian Murray & Mark Hopkins

runners.name: Cornelienne
runners.spotlight: Useful on the Flat in France, winning twice and Listed-placed; bought for E250,000 at the Arqana sales in late 2024; off for over a year before a run on the Flat at Dundalk last November; useful form in two maiden hurdle starts, 12l second to Bambino Fever on the second occasion; career-best was over 1m7f in a Listed race, this might be too sharp.
runners.comment: Two wins and Listed-placed in France, useful form in two maiden hurdle starts last winter

runners.name: Chica Guerrera
runners.spotlight: Gained third career win at Down Royal in June, bolting up over a similar trip to this; hit with a 14lb rise for that; struggled over 1m4f in a premier handicap at Galway last week, bringing a consistent sequence to an end; this trip is closer to her optimum.
runners.comment: Hit with a 14lb rise for a Down Royal win, struggled over 1m4f at Galway last week

races.race_name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Lady Patrona
runners.spotlight: Creditable runs since debut second over 5f at Naas; fourth to subsequent Group 2 winner Sun Goddess over 6f at the Curragh, and latest Naas fourth over 5f has worked out well.
runners.comment: Twice fourth since debut second at the Curragh, looks good enough to win in this company
runners.owner: Miss Kate Harrington & Mrs John Harrington & B Phelan

runners.name: Emotional Hedging
runners.spotlight: E15,000 yearling; first foal; by Bayside Boy; dam 1m winner for Dermot Weld, half-sister to two winners; worth a market check.
runners.comment: First foal, by Bayside Boy; dam 1m winner for Dermot Weld, worth a market check

runners.name: Lucy's Promise
runners.spotlight: Did not show much on first two starts; took a step in the right direction when a staying-on sixth of 17 at Navan, in front of The Green Helmet (seventh) and Candle Glow (tenth); however, confidence is dented by her eclipse in a Curragh nursery, never looked like featuring, last of eight.
runners.comment: In front of The Green Helmet and Candle Glow at Navan, in rear in a Curragh nursery

runners.name: The Green Helmet
runners.spotlight: Cotai Glory colt out of an unraced half-sister to Trawlerman; lots of stamina in the pedigree; showed up well enough when seventh over 6f at Navan on debut; faces rematch with Lucy's Promise (sixth) and Candle Glow (tenth); could be a factor now with normal improvement.
runners.comment: Showed up well enough at Navan on debut, could be a factor now with normal improvement

runners.name: Outside Sun
runners.spotlight: E2,000 yearling; first foal; Twilight Sun filly whose dam (by Iffraaj) won three races for the Johnstons; half-sister to winners Etes Vous Prets (Japanese 7f Grade 2) and Hawkesbury (UAE 1m Listed), out of 1m Group 1 winner.
runners.comment: Cheap yearling but has a decent pedigree, dam won three races for the Johnstons

runners.name: Arizonaneargalway
runners.spotlight: Lost ground at the start and was tailed off at Leopardstown; can be ruled out.
runners.comment: Lost ground at the start and was tailed off at Leopardstown, can be ruled out

runners.name: Cloughleagh Bridge
runners.spotlight: Failed to go forward from a respectable 7f Leopardstown debut when finishing in rear over 1m at Bellewstown.
runners.comment: Failed to go forward from her Leopardstown debut when finishing in rear at Bellewstown

runners.name: Closed Loop
runners.spotlight: Massive price when finishing with only one behind in an 18-runner maiden at Naas a fortnight ago.
runners.comment: Massive price when finishing with only one behind in an 18-runner maiden at Naas

runners.name: Roeillaun
runners.spotlight: Plenty of improvement needed from her opening efforts at Naas and Cork; her trainer appears to have a better chance with Elyatta.
runners.comment: Plenty of improvement needed, her trainer appears to have a better chance with Elyatta

runners.name: Tango Club
runners.spotlight: Was beginning to get going late in a 5f maiden at Cork 12 days ago; longer distance should suit and she may be able to build on that initial outing.
runners.comment: Was beginning to get going late in a 5f maiden at Cork, longer distance should suit

runners.name: Elyatta
runners.spotlight: Mid-division in maidens at Fairyhouse and Roscommon; may get closer to the action now with the champion jockey aboard; trainer also runs Roeillaun with another leading rider aboard.
runners.comment: Mid-division in maidens at Fairyhouse and Roscommon, may get closer to the action now

runners.name: Candle Glow
runners.spotlight: Not far behind Lucy's Promise (sixth) and The Green Helmet (seventh) when tenth of 17 at Navan; open to improvement.
runners.comment: Not far behind Lucy's Promise and The Green Helmet at Navan, open to improvement

runners.name: Matavai Bay
runners.spotlight: Faded to finish last of ten first time out at Gowran; unlikely to feature.
runners.comment: Faded to finish last of ten first time out at Gowran, unlikely to feature

races.race_name: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Tatianna
runners.spotlight: Best of three maiden runs was on debut over 5f on soft ground at Cork; ran out a clear-cut winner of a five-runner 5f contest on handicap debut at Down Royal; up 6lb now and might be vulnerable in rematch with hampered third Mr Montauk.
runners.comment: Won well at Down Royal, might struggle to uphold form with the hampered third Mr Montauk

runners.name: Exchange Student
runners.spotlight: Ran in a strong maiden at the Curragh on her second outing; in rear on all three starts; she will possibly find her level in handicaps; however, hard to be confident.
runners.comment: In rear on all three starts, she will possibly find her level now, hard to be confident

runners.name: Woodlawn Lily
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far when fourth of six on debut at Cork (5f, soft); no sign of progress on her next two starts; fifth of eight in a stronger nursery than this at the Curragh last month; that experience could be an asset now.
runners.comment: Fifth of eight in a stronger nursery at the Curragh, that experience could be an asset now

runners.name: Two Brigade
runners.spotlight: Ran in decent company over 6f at Naas on his second start; drop to 5f at Bellewstown did not seem to suit him; may improve with cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Ran in decent company at Naas on his second start, may improve with cheekpieces

runners.name: Ballymackney
runners.spotlight: Weak form in two 5f outings; no better over 7f last time at Leopardstown; first-time blinkers will need to have a transformative impact.
runners.comment: Weak form in two 5f outings, no better over 7f last time, tried with blinkers now

runners.name: Mr Montauk
runners.spotlight: Three qualifying runs over 5f, all within the space of three weeks in April/May; sent off second-favourite for a 5f Down Royal nursery last month, got outpaced and then hampered at a crucial stage when staying on; could now reverse form with the winner Tatianna.
runners.comment: Hampered at a crucial stage at Down Royal, could reverse form with the winner Tatianna

runners.name: Hi Corbett Court
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in two maidens over 6f, though got into the money at Navan on the first occasion; not beaten far in fifth when taking on winners over 5f at Cork; faces much weaker opposition now and looks capable of making his presence felt.
runners.comment: Not beaten far in fifth when taking on winners over 5f at Cork, much weaker opposition now

runners.name: Littlepacer
runners.spotlight: Hard to make a case for her despite having contested maidens at three of the top tracks.
runners.comment: Hard to make a case for her despite having contested maidens at three of the top tracks

runners.name: The Drambling Man
runners.spotlight: Only mild promise in four maiden attempts; his opening handicap mark does not seem lenient.
runners.comment: Only mild promise in maidens, his opening handicap mark does not seem lenient

runners.name: Stellar Path
runners.spotlight: Has finished in front of only a few rivals in her qualifying races; worth noting that her trainer won this with an unexposed type last year; cheekpieces may help.
runners.comment: In front of only a few rivals in her qualifying races, trainer won this race last year

runners.name: No Time Faults
runners.spotlight: Slight improvement from Naas debut to Navan next time; moderate run over 5f at Cork recently; others preferred.
runners.comment: The second of her three starts was respectable, moderate run over 5f at Cork recently

runners.name: Fine Line
runners.spotlight: Three-figure odds for all three starts in maidens and has run accordingly; her opening mark looks quite high.
runners.comment: Three-figure odds for all three starts in maidens, her opening mark looks quite high

runners.name: Sophia Royale
runners.spotlight: Has beaten only two of her 29 rivals in three races; has been given a low rating, but unlikely to feature on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Has beaten only two of her 29 rivals in three races, handicap debut, unlikely to feature

races.race_name: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap

runners.name: Countertop
runners.spotlight: Had shown very little until front-running 200-1 fifth in 9.5f maiden at Ballinrobe; dropping back in trip might suit; second runner for yard.
runners.comment: A bit better when a front-running fifth in 9.5f maiden at Ballinrobe; trip might suit

runners.name: Luminessa
runners.spotlight: Glimmers of ability in maidens and first couple of handicaps; prominent before fading in final furlong when beaten 5l at Naas on Monday; visor replaces blinkers.
runners.comment: Glimmers of ability; prominent but faded when beaten 5l at Naas on Monday; now visored
runners.owner: Scott Sterling & Darragh Cuffe & Conor Keohane

runners.name: Jampa Ling
runners.spotlight: AW maiden winner and best turf run was when third of 17 over 6f at Fairyhouse in June; well beaten in race won by Glen Breeze at Limerick; better effort when just behind Dubai Opulence in all-aged contest at Cork.
runners.comment: AW maiden winner and best turf run was when third over 6f at Fairyhouse in June

runners.name: Beau Army
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner but placed just once from nine starts on turf, that when third over 1m at Killarney; first-time cheekpieces were no help when faded tamely over 7f at Gowran.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner but placed just once from nine starts on turf, that when third over 1m

runners.name: Magna Kotcha
runners.spotlight: Mildly promising debut over 1m at Naas in March, but heavy defeats since; out the back in Killarney claimer last time, and drops in trip now.
runners.comment: Promising debut in March but heavy defeats since, in 1m Killarney claimer last time

runners.name: She's On The Ball
runners.spotlight: Last two handicap runs, against older rivals over 7f/6f, have been creditable and has a decent draw.
runners.comment: Last two handicap runs over 7f/6f have been quite creditable and has a decent draw

runners.name: Sand Art
runners.spotlight: Fair effort three starts back at Down Royal when beaten 6.5l by subsequent huge improver, but hasn't built on that; blinkers now tried.
runners.comment: Fair effort three starts back at Down Royal (beaten 6.5l), but hasn't built on that

runners.name: Glen Breeze
runners.spotlight: Had shown promise in 6f handicaps before winning over 6.5f at Limerick and was badly drawn at Gowran last time; some reasonable runs on soft ground early in the year, so if the rain comes, it may not scupper his chance.
runners.comment: Had shown promise before winning over 6.5f at Limerick and was badly drawn at Gowran since

runners.name: Windsor Lily
runners.spotlight: Not clear run in first-time blinkers when around 6l off Glen Breeze at Limerick; yard has turned the corner, but the fact that she's entered in a claimer for 4k on Friday wouldn't inspire confidence.
runners.comment: Not clear run in first-time blinkers when around 6l off Glen Breeze at Limerick

runners.name: Dubai Opulence
runners.spotlight: Decent runs in 6f all-aged handicaps on good/good to firm last twice, notably his Navan fourth to progressive type; first run in 3yo only handicap, but easy ground would be an unknown.
runners.comment: Decent runs in 6f handicaps on good/good to firm last twice; easy ground may be a concern
runners.owner: Syndicates Racing/W Jones/N O'Hare/Kabin Racing Syndicate

runners.name: Apothic Red
runners.spotlight: Yet to place, but two creditable efforts in big-field Curragh handicaps and has had a break since finishing tamely over 7f at Gowran; handles an ease and headgear goes on; drops in grade too.
runners.comment: Yet to place, but creditable efforts in big-field Curragh handicaps and handles an ease
runners.owner: Mrs Pauline McCourt/Donal O'Leary/Don't Ask The Wife Synd

runners.name: Unfamiliar
runners.spotlight: Winner over 7f at Limerick last month, but pair of heavy defeats at Galway festival; wouldn't dismiss her chance back in less competitive contest here.
runners.comment: Winner over 7f at Limerick last month, but heavy defeats since, including at Galway

runners.name: The Love Machine
runners.spotlight: Nursery winner over 6f for Michael Mulvany, but has shown little for current yard; bit better when fifth of seven over 5f at Down Royal.
runners.comment: Nursery winner for Michael Mulvany, but has shown little for current yard

runners.name: Quinn's Charm
runners.spotlight: Respectable form in 7f/1m nurseries and has come down 9lb from initial mark; 11 months off.
runners.comment: Respectable form in nurseries and has come down 9lb from initial mark; 11 months off

races.race_name: Guinness Handicap

runners.name: Sonny Corleone
runners.spotlight: Formerly with Private Larry's trainer; promise in maidens, particularly at Down Royal on stable debut;  modest handicap debut over 1m4f on AW and now blinkered.
runners.comment: Formerly with Private Larry's trainer; promise in maidens but modest handicap debut on AW

runners.name: Grey Intentions
runners.spotlight: First handicap run over 1m was okay, but well beaten over 10.5f in May; blinkers replace cheekpieces and pedigree suggests she might stay, but plenty to prove.
runners.comment: First handicap run over 1m was okay, but well beaten over 10.5f in May; blinkers fitted
runners.owner: Thomas J Quinn & Brian P Whelan

runners.name: Chicago Moon
runners.spotlight: Beat Canon Law by 2.5l at Killarney and now 9lb higher; that was only her second handicap start and rider thinks she'll stay farther than that extended 1m3f trip.
runners.comment: Beat Canon Law by 2.5l at Killarney; rider thinks she'll stay farther than that 1m3f trip
runners.owner: Samuel M Mencoff & Anthony Paul Smurfit

runners.name: Elzaam Express
runners.spotlight: Has been beaten 24l+ in three maidens at up to 10.5f; headgear on for handicap debut and not really bred for this far.
runners.comment: Has been beaten 24l+ in her three maidens at up to 10.5f, headgear on for handicap debut

runners.name: Canon Law
runners.spotlight: Went closest to first win when front-running second to Chicago Moon over extended 1m3f at Killarney; same tactics were used last time over 1m4f at Cork when faded late to finish fifth.
runners.comment: Went closest to first win when front-running second to Chicago Moon over 1m3f at Killarney

runners.name: Curious Jane
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; not beaten that far in first two handicaps over around 1m1f; markedly up in trip, but related to 1m3f winner and Listed-winning dam won over 1m6f.
runners.comment: Second runner for yard; not beaten that far in first two handicaps; markedly up in trip

runners.name: Queen Of Astolat
runners.spotlight: Bought for 15,000gns lately; maiden's best run was when third over 11.5f on soft ground at Yarmouth; third of four over 1m6f at same track on last start for Charlie Fellowes.
runners.comment: Bought for 15,000gns lately; best run for Charlie Fellowes was third over 11.5f on soft

runners.name: Mare Crisium
runners.spotlight: Best effort so far when front-running fourth over 9.5f at Ballinrobe; trip is a concern.
runners.comment: Best effort so far when front-running fourth over 9.5f at Ballinrobe; trip is a concern

runners.name: Ellens Bay
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to three winners at up to 1m; never a factor in her maidens over 7f; marked step up in trip for first handicap.
runners.comment: Half-sister to three winners at up to 1m; never a factor in her maidens; first handicap

runners.name: Cascade Canyon
runners.spotlight: Couple of okay runs in maidens, but beaten 21l on handicap debut at Limerick two runs back and tailed off in maiden at same venue since; headgear on and champion jockey rides.
runners.comment: Couple of okay runs in maidens, but beaten 21l on handicap debut two runs back; headgear

runners.name: Private Larry
runners.spotlight: Last-to-first victor over 1m4f at Bellewstown (solid form for 0-60 grade); went up 11lb for decisive nature of that win; beaten fractions when third on hurdling debut since.
runners.comment: Last to first victor over 1m4f at Bellewstown (solid form); ran well over hurdles since

races.race_name: Rockshore Cider Handicap

runners.name: Reflectionist
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced since back-to-back wins over hurdles in 2023; on second start for this yard, bolted up over this trip at Ballinrobe where cheekpieces went on for the first time and usual tongue-tie was discarded; 13lb rise still leaves him eligible for basement grade.
runners.comment: Bolted up over this trip at Ballinrobe; 13lb rise still leaves him eligible for same grade

runners.name: Preparations
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; 1m4f and hurdles winner; not clearest of runs when 14l off Reflectionist at Ballinrobe last time.
runners.comment: 1m4f and hurdles winner; not clearest of runs when 14l off Reflectionist latest; reserve

runners.name: Without Love
runners.spotlight: AW winner has been second over around 1m4f on turf last twice; just in front of Young Churchill at Limerick last time; softening ground might be a concern, as he's not proven on it.
runners.comment: AW winner has been second over around 1m4f last twice; softening ground might be a concern

runners.name: Kings Gesture
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; modest form so far and was tailed off behind Reflectionist at Ballinrobe last month; tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Modest form so far and was tailed off behind Reflectionist at Ballinrobe; reserve

runners.name: Eastern Wind
runners.spotlight: Five Flat wins; good second of 19 over this trip at Leopardstown in May, but has struggled since; goes on any ground.
runners.comment: Five Flat wins and good second over this trip at Leopardstown in May; has struggled since

runners.name: Deluca Chop
runners.spotlight: 7yo has hit a rich vein of form this year; no worse than third in six starts and on a hat-trick after hard-fought wins over this trip at Navan and Down Royal; ground-versatile.
runners.comment: On a hat-trick after wins over this trip at Navan and Down Royal; 7yo is ground-versatile

runners.name: Autocrat
runners.spotlight: First reserve; all six wins have been on AW and placed only once in 20 starts on turf; well beaten in race won by Reflectionist at Ballinrobe.
runners.comment: All six wins have been on AW and placed only once in 20 starts on turf; reserve

runners.name: Mystic Rose
runners.spotlight: Small filly has had some fair runs on turf, but AW third over 1m4f was her first time to be placed; stuck to her task well in first-time cheekpieces that day.
runners.comment: Some fair runs on turf, but AW third over 1m4f was her first time to be placed

runners.name: Maxwell Smart
runners.spotlight: Winner over this trip last year; has mixed Flat racing with hurdling this year; decent fifth, less than 2l off Deluca Chop, at Navan in June and good run over hurdles a week later; not as effective lately; ground-versatile.
runners.comment: Winner over this trip last year; decent fifth, less than 2l off Deluca Chop, at Navan
runners.owner: Mrs P McCourt/Whyte's Stamullen Synd'/D O'Leary/J McNally

runners.name: Piatra Neamt
runners.spotlight: Glimmers of ability, including on latest when beaten 4.5l over 1m4f at Roscommon in May; visor on then, back to cheekpieces here; handles soft ground.
runners.comment: Glimmers of ability, including on latest when beaten 4.5l over 1m4f at Roscommon in May

runners.name: Charlie Brow'n
runners.spotlight: Winner over 1m6f at Navan in October and ran well at Galway next time; six month layoff since hurdles outing early this year; goes well on soft.
runners.comment: Winner over 1m6f at Navan in October and ran well at Galway next time; six month layoff

runners.name: Young Churchill
runners.spotlight: Had useful maiden form at three for Noel Meade and landed maiden hurdle last summer; hit form for this yard when close third over 1m4f at Limerick, and kept on steadily when beaten 4l over extended 1m3f at Killarney; waited with lately, so wide draw won't matter much.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler is closely matched with Without Love on Limerick running; beaten 4l since

runners.name: Plus Or Minus
runners.spotlight: Modest form in seven Flat starts and was 16l behind Deluca Chop at Down Royal on seasonal debut in June; no better since.
runners.comment: Modest form in seven Flat starts and was 16l behind Deluca Chop at Down Royal in June

runners.name: God The Highness
runners.spotlight: Maiden was touched off over C&D on last year's card, and some good efforts on soft or heavy ground in the autumn; form not as good this term and was too keen in cheekpieces when beaten 7l by Deluca Chop at Navan last time.
runners.comment: Touched off over C&D on last year's card; beaten 7l by Deluca Chop at Navan last time

runners.name: Wungudi
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced mare has been off since handicap debut on AW in November, beaten around 6l over 10.5f; tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Lightly-raced mare has been off since handicap debut on AW in November, beaten around 6l

runners.name: Think About It
runners.spotlight: Yet to place in 12 starts; fair effort on latest handicap start when beaten less than 6l over 10.5f here in May.
runners.comment: Yet to place in 12 starts; fair effort when beaten less than 6l over 10.5f here in May

runners.name: Anightaway
runners.spotlight: Maiden has been off since March when beaten 12l over 1m2f at Navan; tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Maiden has been off since March when beaten 12l over 1m2f at Navan; tongue-tie

races.race_name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Crowned
runners.spotlight: Has made the frame under 7lb claimer in sprint maidens at Windsor and Nottingham, doing enough to think he can make his mark in ordinary nurseries; Colin Keane is booked for this first attempt; interesting.
runners.comment: Has made the frame under 7lb claimer in maidens; Colin Keane is booked for nursery debut

runners.name: Tallahassee Lassie
runners.spotlight: Has shown steady progress on turf; won at Ffos Las (5f; nursery debut) most recently, leaving the impression this return to 6f will suit; half-sister to a smart performer who is 2-2 on AW; respected.
runners.comment: Won at Ffos Las in latest turf start; half-sister to a smart performer who is 2-2 on AW

runners.name: Nascent Star
runners.spotlight: Has shown ability over 5f while twice leaving the impression he'll be well suited by today's extra furlong; made late gains, without landing a blow, in the Super Sprint last time; one to consider.
runners.comment: Has shown ability over 5f while twice leaving the impression this longer trip will suit

runners.name: Time And Effort
runners.spotlight: Faced stiff task on penultimate start; has some AW winners in her pedigree and ran well (2l second) in 6f novice event at Southwell switched to this sphere last time; may build on that effort; possibilities.
runners.comment: Ran well at Southwell switched to AW last time; may build on that effort; possibilities

runners.name: Invincible Isaac
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who has inconsistent form and seems to be more exposed than most of today's rivals; failed to improve for visor last time; headgear retained.
runners.comment: Five-race maiden who has inconsistent form and looks comparatively exposed

runners.name: Pageant Girl
runners.spotlight: Raced only on turf; has failed to back up the form of her spring win at Ripon; chance depends on the effects of new surface and another change of headgear.
runners.comment: Chance depends on the effects on new surface and another change of headgear

runners.name: Kochella
runners.spotlight: Showed promise on debut; has failed to beat a rival at Royal Ascot and Yarmouth for new yard since but this switch to nursery level may prompt a turnaround.
runners.comment: Best effort on debut; this switch to nursery level may prompt a resurgence

runners.name: Najmet Minzaal
runners.spotlight: Similar type to Nascent Star, having shown some promise over 5f while looking as if she'll benefit from this step up to 6f; not disgraced when favourite on nursery debut last time; still of interest.
runners.comment: Similar type to Nascent Star as this step up to 6f is likely to prove beneficial

runners.name: Trust Yourself
runners.spotlight: Not fully solid on his turf novice form but appeared to show some improvement last time and a subsequent physical tweak (wind surgery) may prompt another step forward.
runners.comment: Seemed to show some improvement in latest novice start; had wind surgery since

runners.name: Secret Rival
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who posted clear best effort when sixth at Newbury; not the most convincing contender on form but she's in good hands and may improve now handicapping.
runners.comment: Not the most convincing contender on form but may improve now handicapping

runners.name: Its A Ginger Thing
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who looks the type to benefit from stepping out of novice level but doesn't appear to have a generous opening mark; not well treated on bare figures.
runners.comment: Doesn't appear to have a generous opening mark; not well treated on bare figures
runners.owner: E Kelly, J Woods, N Gallagher & Partner

runners.name: Beach Ahead
runners.spotlight: Has shown ability with fourth-place finishes at Windsor and Goodwood; may be capable of progress in nurseries and yard keeps it in the family with Toby Moore taking off 7lb; one to bear in mind.
runners.comment: May be capable of progress and yard keeps it in the family with Toby Moore taking off 7lb

races.race_name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)

runners.name: Off The Peg
runners.spotlight: 150,000gns yearling; didn't enjoy the clearest of runs when sixth of ten on his Newbury debut (6f, good to firm) last month (fifth has won since); shortlisted with the experience on his side.
runners.comment: Didn't enjoy the clearest of runs when sixth on his Newbury debut last month; shortlisted
runners.owner: B Dickson, P Cook & R Rexton

runners.name: Chymbulak
runners.spotlight: March foal by Dark Angel; 450,000gns yearling; brother to winners Charyn (6f/1m including 2yo/Group 1; RPR 127) and Wings Of War (6f including 2yo Group 2; 110); dam Listed-placed 5f winner (including AW; 99), out of 5f 2yo winning sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Galeota; in-form stable gets plenty of 2yo winners first time out and his pedigree makes a market check crucial.
runners.comment: Stable in top form and his pedigree makes him well worth a market check

runners.name: Ahmadi
runners.spotlight: March foal by St Mark's Basilica; 110,000euros yearling; half-brother to 1m1f 2yo/1m2f winner South Island (RPR 101); dam 1m2f-1m3f winner (including French Listed; 100), half-sister to winners Acadius (7.5f Listed), Aconito (7f/1m4f), Andraxt (9.5f) and A Kind Of Magic (1m3f); stable has a fine record with 2yo newcomers and plenty to like on pedigree; entered in the Goffs Million.
runners.comment: Stable has a fine record with 2yo newcomers and plenty to like on pedigree

runners.name: Minzazi
runners.spotlight: March foal by Minzaal; 42,000gns foal, 58,000gns yearling; half-brother to winners Another Investment (6f/7f including 2yo; RPR 95), Shrara (6f 2yo; 71) and Ibn Alwaleed (KSA 1m 2yo); dam US 5f 2yo/6f dirt winner, half-sister to 7f Listed winner Council Member; stable gets its share of 2yo winners first time and worth monitoring in the market.
runners.comment: Stable gets its share of 2yo winners first time and worth monitoring in the market

runners.name: Native Chief
runners.spotlight: February foal by Sioux Nation; 45,000gns foal, 55,000gns yearling; half-brother to six winners including Orchid (6f AW including 2yo; RPR 88), True Wisdom (1m 2yo; 85), Light Beam (UAE 1m1f; 81) and Clear White Light (1m4f Flat, 72; 2m-2m4f hurdle); dam 7f/1m winner (including Listed; 100); stable has the occasional 2yo winner first time, but probably only of interest if backed.
runners.comment: Stable has the occasional 2yo winner first time, but probably only of interest if backed

runners.name: Vardo
runners.spotlight: March foal by Minzaal; 52,000gns foal, 58,000gns yearling, 95,000gns breeze-up 2yo; half-brother to 5f 2yo winner Vishaka (RPR 71); dam 8.6f AW winner (56), half-sister to winners Dancing King (1m6f Group 3) and Starstruck (US 1m1f Grade 3), out of smart 5f/6f winner; tongue tied on debut and others appeal a bit more on breeding, but his stable's fine record with 2yo newcomers makes him worth a market check.
runners.comment: Stable's fine record with 2yo newcomers makes him worth a market check

runners.name: Greenlander
runners.spotlight: February foal by U S Navy Flag; 25,000gns yearling; half-brother to five winners including Interlocuter (1m-10.5f including AW/France/Australia; RPR 104), Spellwork (1m; 104) and Aslan (UAE 1m1f-1m3f; 93); dam UAE 1,000 Guineas/UAE Oaks winner (109), sister to Middle Park winner Lujain; plenty to like on breeding, but stable has few 2yos go in first time.
runners.comment: Plenty to like on breeding, but stable has few 2yos go in first time
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Minzaal Time
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in three starts over 6f/7f on turf/AW; gelded since last seen and it will need to have made a dramatic difference; low-grade handicaps may be more his thing; stable also runs Off The Peg.
runners.comment: Well beaten in three starts; gelded since last seen; low-grade handicaps likely his thing

races.race_name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)

runners.name: Clive The Writer
runners.spotlight: Friendless in the betting but showed some promise, amid greenness, in 7f event at Newbury where he kept on for seventh of 12; the form received a boost at Glorious Goodwood last week; the pick of the runners with experience.
runners.comment: Showed some promise at Newbury; the form received a boost at Goodwood last week

runners.name: Montalbano
runners.spotlight: 70,000gns yearling; Saxon Warrior half-brother to two winners, notably Albula (Group-placed 1m 2yo; RPR 98); dam Australian 7.7f/1m scorer (including Group 3; 103); represents in-form major yard; respected newcomer.
runners.comment: 70,000gns yearling; by Saxon Warrior; represents in-form major yard; respected  newcomer

runners.name: Great Plains
runners.spotlight: 24,000euros then £10,000 yearling, 20,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; Sioux Nation half-brother to Italian 5f 2yo winner Many Kisses, out of 1m winner (including 2yo; RPR 75); others are more interesting.
runners.comment: 20,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; by Sioux Nation; others are more interesting

runners.name: Dover Street
runners.spotlight: 16,000euros foal, £62,000 yearling; Persian Force half-brother to 7.5f 2yo winner Leblon Queen (RPR 62), out of unraced half-sister to Swedish 1m3f scorer Sel Sea; Amo/Hannon newcomer who is one to bear in mind.
runners.comment: £62,000 yearling; Persian Force half-brother to 7.5f 2yo winner; one to bear in mind

runners.name: Ghost Raider
runners.spotlight: 90,000euros foal; by Invincible Spirit and first foal of 6f/7f winner (including 2yo/Listed; RPR 109); major stable; possibilities.
runners.comment: 90,000euros foal; by Invincible Spirit and first foal of 6f/7f winner (including 2yo)

runners.name: Gold Army
runners.spotlight: 48,000gns foal, 105,000gns yearling; by Intello and first foal of French 7f turf/7.5f AW scorer (RPR 86) who is half-sister to three Group winners and daughter of 5f 2yo Group 3 winner; likely type, based on sales information and pedigree.
runners.comment: 105,000gns yearling; by Intello and first foal of French turf/AW scorer; likely type

runners.name: Moda Rosa
runners.spotlight: Sole filly in this field; similar type to Sayid Harry Angel having been beaten about 11l in Newbury event (6.5f) on debut, finishing sixth of seven; may improve with that outing under her belt.
runners.comment: Sixth of seven at Newbury; may improve with that outing under her belt

runners.name: Sayid Harry Angel
runners.spotlight: Always behind and finished last of ten, beaten about 11l, in 6f contest at Newbury having been easy to back; however, may fare better upped to 7f with that experience under his belt.
runners.comment: Last of ten in 6f contest at Newbury but may do better upped to 7f

races.race_name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Kaindy
runners.spotlight: Built on his debut here (7f) last October when second of nine at Newcastle (7f, Tapeta) the following month, coming clear with a subsequent winner; returns from nine months off having been gelded and is respected despite widest draw; bang-in-form stable won this with a newcomer last year.
runners.comment: Runner-up on his second start at Newcastle last November; stable in hot form; watch market

runners.name: Black Chiffon
runners.spotlight: Sent off 4-1 when making a winning debut at Salisbury (7f, good) last October (race has produced winners); high on list for in-form yard, especially if market positive.
runners.comment: Made a winning debut at Salisbury last October; high on list for in-form yard

runners.name: Colonnade
runners.spotlight: 9-1 when third of 11 on his Windsor debut (1m, good to firm) last month (runner-up has won since); half-brother to a couple of AW winners and one for the shortlist.
runners.comment: Third on his Windsor debut last month; half-brother to a couple of AW winners; shortlisted

runners.name: Gavriel
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival on his debut in a four-runner Sandown maiden (1m, good) a year ago, but improved when just getting up to win a novice over this C&D later that month (race has produced winners); may appreciate a bit further now, but still respected on his return and market should be informative.
runners.comment: Won narrowly on second start over C&D just under a year ago; respected on return

runners.name: Charlie's Cannon
runners.spotlight: Sent off 12-1 but overcame a slow start and greenness when making a winning debut for Ralph Beckett in a 7f novice here last month; changed hands for 55,000gns soon afterwards; has a wide draw to overcome, but that initial effort was a taking one.
runners.comment: Made winning debut for Ralph Beckett here last month; has a wide draw, but still respected

runners.name: Tatafortino
runners.spotlight: 3,500euros yearling; half-brother to six winners including Triticum Vulgare (Italian 6f-1m1f including 2yo/Listed; RPR 87), Just Paul (7f/7.4f; 86) and Free One (7f AW; 78); dam placed 1m2f/1m4f (70); already gelded and would be a very rare winning newcomer from the yard.
runners.comment: Already gelded and would be a very rare winning newcomer from the yard

runners.name: Virtue King
runners.spotlight: 90,000gns yearling; half-brother to winners Cajole (7f/1m including AW/Listed; RPR 104), Theoryofeverything (Group-placed 7f-1m1f; 102) and Persist (1m/1m2f; 100); dam 1m winner (including 2yo/AW/Group 1; 121), half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner Creative Force; appealing pedigree but stable not known for winning newcomers.
runners.comment: Appealing pedigree but stable not known for winning newcomers

runners.name: Lady Blitzle
runners.spotlight: Dam unraced half-sister to 5f/6f winner Stone Circle, out of maiden half-sister to Listed-placed 7f-1m2f winner Valentina Guest; apprentice-ridden on debut and stable has few winners first time out.
runners.comment: Apprentice-ridden on debut and stable has few winners first time out

runners.name: Najidi Storm
runners.spotlight: Brother to winners Logician (1m2f-14.5f including St Leger; RPR 121) and Collide (1m1f-1m6f including AW; 112), half-brother to six winners including Okeechobee (1m-1m2f including AW/Group 3; 117); dam 1m winner (103), half-sister to 1m1f Group 1 winner Cityscape; stable doesn't have many winners first time out, but he's still worth a market check given his classy pedigree.
runners.comment: Stable has few winners first time out, but still worth a market check given his pedigree

runners.name: Classy Night
runners.spotlight: 68,000gns yearling; half-brother to winners Vantheman (5f/6f including 2yo/AW; RPR 99) and Whisky McGonagall (5f including AW; 76); dam 6f winner (79), half-sister to 5f Listed winner/Nunthorpe runner-up Hamish McGonagall; already gelded and bred more for speed, while the stable doesn't have many winning newcomers.
runners.comment: Bred more for speed and stable doesn't have many winning newcomers

runners.name: Talking Bear
runners.spotlight: 22,000gns yearling; dam twice-raced sister to 1m3f winner Utile, half-sister to 6f 2yo Listed winner Straight Answer, out of Group-placed 7f 2yo winning half-sister to 1m2f Group 1 winner Announce; already gelded and doesn't look a likely winner on debut.
runners.comment: Already gelded and doesn't look a likely winner on debut

runners.name: Kino Plasmat
runners.spotlight: Fourth in two turf maidens (7f/1m) in June; nicely bred and should win races, but possibly in handicaps after this.
runners.comment: Fourth in two turf maidens in June; should win races, but possibly in handicaps after this

runners.name: That's All Folks
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in three bumpers and a maiden hurdle; returns from another long absence having undergone wind surgery; no appeal.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in three bumpers and a maiden hurdle; no appeal

runners.name: Lunar Tide
runners.spotlight: Two starts for Joseph O'Brien earlier in year, appreciating the drop in trip when winning a Gowran Park maiden (1m, soft) in April; picked up for 34,000gns the following month and the market may indicate what is expected on stable debut.
runners.comment: Won a Gowran Park maiden for Joseph O'Brien in April; watch market on stable debut

races.race_name: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div I)

runners.name: Dialstone
runners.spotlight: Related to a few winners for his yard; duly showed promise in 1m2f event at Ffos Las where he was slowly away, looked green and raced in last place until making good late headway and nearly getting up; respected with progress on the cards.
