runners.comment: Related to winners for his yard; went very close in Ffos Las event; should progress
runners.owner: A D G Oldrey & G C Hartigan

runners.name: Fortitudine
runners.spotlight: Gelded son of Dubawi; siblings include two Group/Grade 1 winners for his connections, notably prolific Rebel's Romance (1m-1m6f; RPR 124) who recently retired; very interesting newcomer, especially if the market speaks positively.
runners.comment: Siblings include two Group/Grade 1 winners for his connections, notably Rebel's Romance

runners.name: Purple Moon
runners.spotlight: From the family of his smart namesake; raced twice for Pat O'Rourke, belying 80-1 odds with emphatic success at Gowran Park (9.5f) last time; sold for 65,000gns since; sets the form standard upped further in trip.
runners.comment: Raced twice in Ireland; belied 80-1 odds with Gowran Park win last time; the form pick

runners.name: Treble Bass
runners.spotlight: Only a modest sixth of nine in 1m2f maiden at Windsor but is nicely bred and may be capable of improvement with that outing under his belt; one of two runners for Godolphin.
runners.comment: Nicely bred; modest sixth at Windsor but may improve with that outing under his belt

runners.name: Anchor
runners.spotlight: Tailed-off last of seven in bumper; opposed.
runners.comment: Tailed-off last of seven in bumper

runners.name: Barachiel
runners.spotlight: Flat-bred 5yo who showed best form in bumpers when runner-up at Taunton on penultimate start; out of depth (well beaten) in Aintree Grade 2 latest; returns to a more suitable level on debut in this sphere.
runners.comment: Flat bred; best form in bumpers when runner-up at Taunton on penultimate start

runners.name: Arklan
runners.spotlight: Never-dangerous fifth, one place behind Digger One, in 11.5f event at Windsor having been slowly away; however, may do better with that experience under his belt.
runners.comment: Never dangerous at Windsor but may do better with that experience under his belt

runners.name: Mid Flight
runners.spotlight: Needs improvement on his 1m efforts (turf/AW) last autumn for Ger Lyons; sold for 12,000gns and gelded since; visor is added on reappearance; the betting may give further guidance.
runners.comment: Needs improvement on his 1m efforts last autumn for Ger Lyons; visor added

runners.name: Westender
runners.spotlight: Absent and gelded since inauspicious effort (tailed-off last of 11) in 7f maiden at Sandown over a year ago; best watched unless the market suggests otherwise.
runners.comment: Absent and gelded since inauspicious effort at Sandown over a year ago

runners.name: Digger One
runners.spotlight: Holds weak claims on bumper/Flat form, modest fourth at Windsor (11.5f) most recently; however, may improve for the switch to Kempton, being half-brother to a seven-time course winner for his connections.
runners.comment: Weak claims on form but pedigree suggests he may improve for the switch to Kempton

runners.name: Centrum
runners.spotlight: Well bred and represents major connections but hasn't lived up to expectations in two races (turf/AW); perhaps he'll find his feet and show progress in handicaps shortly.
runners.comment: Hasn't lived up to expectations in two races; may find his feet in handicaps soon

runners.name: Be Hopeful
runners.spotlight: Twice-raced gelding who has poor claims on form.
runners.comment: Poor claims on form

races.race_name: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div II)

runners.name: Atlas Mountain
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressive in four starts, the latest when third of 11 at Windsor (1m, good to soft) in June (race has produced a couple of winners); wouldn't be sure to appreciate this longer trip on breeding, though.
runners.comment: Steadily progressive in four starts, but wouldn't be sure to appreciate this longer trip

runners.name: Cloud Forest
runners.spotlight: Improved from his belated debut in May when second of six at Leicester (1m2f, good to firm) last month (fourth has won since); may again find one or two too good conceding weight to the 3yos.
runners.comment: Ran better on second start at Leicester, but may again find one or two too good

runners.name: Kudos Too
runners.spotlight: Improved from his June debut when third of six at Leicester (1m2f, good to firm) last month, but has around 2l to find with Cloud Forest; handicaps may be more suitable.
runners.comment: Third at Leicester last month, but has around 2l to find with Cloud Forest
runners.owner: Mrs R F Greener And North Farm Stud

runners.name: Cuff It
runners.spotlight: Improved from his May debut when winning making all and just holding on in a Windsor novice (1m2f, good to soft) the following month (runner-up 2-2 since); related to AW winners on the dam's side and respected despite penalty.
runners.comment: Just beat a dual subsequent winner at Windsor on second start; respected despite penalty

runners.name: Wreck It Ronnie
runners.spotlight: 10,000euros foal; dam US 1m turf winner, sister to US 1m1f-1m3f Grade 3 winner Tricky Escape, out of US 1m Listed winner; only newcomer in the field and the market should provide clues.
runners.comment: The only newcomer in the field and the market should provide clues

runners.name: Persian Flaw
runners.spotlight: Comfortably held in both starts, the latest over C&D in June; looks one for handicaps.
runners.comment: Comfortably held in both starts, the latest over C&D in June; looks one for handicaps

runners.name: Shadow Road
runners.spotlight: Sent off 12-1 when fourth of 11 on his Newcastle debut (7f, Tapeta) in June; this longer trip should suit, but improvement will be needed.
runners.comment: Fourth on his Newcastle debut in June; longer trip should suit, but improvement needed

runners.name: No Ordinary Joe
runners.spotlight: Useful hurdler (RPR 140) for Nicky Henderson and Faye Bramley, but isn't really bred for this discipline; best watched on stable/Flat debut.
runners.comment: Useful hurdler, but not really bred for this discipline; best watched on stable/Flat debut

runners.name: Church Wedding
runners.spotlight: Evens favourite when beaten 2l into third of 13 on her debut here (1m) in January (race has produced winners); this longer trip should suit on breeding and she's a big player if ready to go after seven months off.
runners.comment: Third on her debut over 1m here in January; the longer trip should suit on breeding

runners.name: Dove Tale
runners.spotlight: 40-1 when well held on her Newmarket debut (7f, good to soft) in November; has an awkward draw, but is bred to be much better than that and the market should be revealing on her return.
runners.comment: Well held on Newmarket debut in November; bred to be much better than that; watch market
runners.owner: G Strawbridge, Ms R Hood & R Evans

races.race_name: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap

runners.name: Victory Ace
runners.spotlight: Has been racing over further since making a successful handicap debut/reappearance at Lingfield (7f, Polytrack) in April, narrowly regaining winning form at Newcastle (1m, Tapeta) 11 days ago; only 2lb higher and return to this trip shouldn't be an issue; cheekpieces given a go.
runners.comment: Won over 7f at Lingfield in April and over 1m at Newcastle last time; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Jumeirah Sands
runners.spotlight: Has continued to run well since winning two Southwell novices (6f, Tapeta) in the spring, most recently when beaten half a length into fourth of ten in a handicap at Wolverhampton (6f, Tapeta) last month (third has won since); extra furlong should be within range; high on the list.
runners.comment: Has continued to run well since winning two Southwell novices in the spring; high on list

runners.name: Piscean Star
runners.spotlight: His two runs over 7f on Polytrack last year were much better than one over 6f on turf, the latest when second of 11 in a Chelmsford novice in September (form worked out well); gelded since and worth a second look on handicap debut after 321 days off.
runners.comment: Form of latest Chelmsford second worked out well; worth a second look on handicap debut

runners.name: Blakefell
runners.spotlight: Made a successful reappearance in a Musselburgh maiden (7f, good) in May and was surrounded by subsequent winners when third of six back there (1m1f, good) last time; shortlisted back down in trip and returned to the AW.
runners.comment: Musselburgh winner in May and latest form back there has been boosted; shortlisted
runners.owner: Alfa Site Services Ltd & Graeme Curnow

runners.name: Angel Gabriel
runners.spotlight: Lingfield novice winner (6f, Polytrack) in December but, having been gelded, has finished well held in two Newmarket handicaps (6f/7f) since returning in June; return to Polytrack is a positive, but he still has a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Well held in two Newmarket handicaps since returning in June; has a bit to prove

runners.name: Captain Fox
runners.spotlight: Made a successful return in an uncompetitive Lingfield novice (1m, Polytrack) in February, but not built on it in two handicaps on turf/Tapeta since; bit more needed back down in trip.
runners.comment: Twice held in handicaps since winning a modest Lingfield novice; down in trip

runners.name: Quadrillion
runners.spotlight: High-class pedigree; made a promising start when beaten a length into third of six at Newmaket (7f, good to firm) in July last year, but regressed in two subsequent outings including on her reappearance in June; market support on this handicap/AW debut would be worth noting.
runners.comment: Regressed in two starts after a promising debut; market support would be worth noting

runners.name: Doodling
runners.spotlight: Regressed after being beaten a neck in a 1m novice here in April, but bounced back to form with a narrow success at Bath (5.7f, good) last time; a few winners have come out of that race and he's shortlisted despite a 3lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Form of latest Bath success has received a few boosts; shortlisted

races.race_name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Desert Belle
runners.spotlight: Consistent in handicaps since winning a Southwell novice (1m4f, Tapeta) in April, only finding one too good in her last two starts; stepping up again in trip may suit her and she again shouldn't be far away with cheekpieces given a go.
runners.comment: Has proved consistent in handicaps; stepping up again in trip may suit her; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Tuba
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who won twice at Wolverhampton (1m6f, Tapeta) and once over hurdles in the spring; up another 4lb on this return to the Flat and may not be allowed his own way this time.
runners.comment: Two wins on the AW and one over hurdles in the spring; may not be allowed his own way

runners.name: Golden Garden
runners.spotlight: Back off the same mark as when making all at Wolverhampton (1m6f, Tapeta) last September when in the care of Jamie Osborne, but not at his best lately and similar tactics won't be easy in this field.
runners.comment: Back off last winning mark, but not at his best lately; may face competition for the lead

runners.name: V Power
runners.spotlight: Three wins at Wolverhampton (1m6f, Tapeta) this year, the latest when just beating a subsequent winner from 3lb lower last month; ran well in one previous visit here and, although yet to attempt this far on the Flat, would be a player if he stays.
runners.comment: Three wins at Wolverhampton this year; would be a player if he stays this new trip

runners.name: Captain Robert
runners.spotlight: Didn't look an easy ride at Yarmouth (1m6f, soft) in June but still managed to win readily; has winning form on Polytrack and is likely to make his presence felt despite a 5lb rise.
runners.comment: Won at Yarmough last time despite not looking the easiest; a player from 5lb higher

runners.name: Roland Garros
runners.spotlight: Sole success came at Catterick (1m4f, good) in April; has been placed over hurdles, but has stamina to prove over this far on the Flat.
runners.comment: 1-18; placed over hurdles, but has stamina to prove over this far on the Flat

runners.name: Individualiste
runners.spotlight: Formerly a fair hurdler/chaser, but the wheels have come right off; no appeal despite another 4lb drop.
runners.comment: Formerly a fair hurdler/chaser, but the wheels have come right off

runners.name: Easter Icon
runners.spotlight: Six wins over 1m6f-16.5f on the Flat including four on the AW; comfortable winner over hurdles in June and a major player.
runners.comment: Six wins over 1m6f-16.5f on the Flat and won comfortably over hurdles in June

races.race_name: Gold & Silver Exchange Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Shades Of May
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been on the AW (7f/1m) but he ran up to his best when third of ten at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) two weeks ago; good claims if coping with the drop back to 6f.
runners.comment: Ran up to his best when third at Salisbury; good claims if coping with the drop back to 6f

runners.name: Indy's Angel
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 23 starts came at Newcastle in September 2024; runner-up at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) and Catterick (7f, good to firm) in July, but ran poorly at Ripon last time; may be able to bounce back.
runners.comment: 1-23; runner-up at Thirsk (6f) and Catterick (7f) in June but ran poorly last time

runners.name: So Grateful
runners.spotlight: 2-41 on turf, the latest success coming at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) last May; runner-up on his last two starts, latest over 5f at that venue 12 days ago, and warrants respect now stepped back up in trip.
runners.comment: 6f Thirsk winner last May; runner-up over 5f on his last two starts; respected

runners.name: Endowed
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner on turf over 6f, most recently at Chepstow last June off 2lb higher; failed to beat a rival on his reappearance and he was behind Shades Of May when seventh at Salisbury (7f) two weeks ago; others preferred.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival on his reappearance and was behind Shades Of May at Salisbury

runners.name: Coiled
runners.spotlight: 17-race maiden who has shown little in three starts since joining this stable; first-time tongue-tie and blinkers combination needs to make a big difference.
runners.comment: 0-17; shown little in three starts for this yard; first-time tongue-tie and blinkers

runners.name: Alafdhal
runners.spotlight: Both wins on turf have been on ground slower than good and his last four wins have been on the AW; beat only one rival home at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) 19 days ago and now drops back in trip with promising amateur Henry Callan taking over in the saddle; visor back on.
runners.comment: Both wins on turf on ground slower than good; beat only one rival home at Newmarket latest

runners.name: Luminous Warrior
runners.spotlight: Runner-up here over 1m two starts back, then went one better here eight days ago, also over 1m; now drops back to 6f for the first time since his second start and that would be a concern under a 5lb penalty.
runners.comment: Carries a 5lb penalty for his win here over 1m eight days ago; drop back in trip a concern

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Speed Of Sound
runners.spotlight: Favourite for debut at Newmarket's July meeting and went down narrowly; the fourth reversed those placings at Ascot (again over 6f on good to firm) but this filly still ran very well in defeat; should be difficult to beat here.
runners.comment: Bang there in 6f races at Newmarket and Ascot; firmly sets the standard

runners.name: Pure Majesty
runners.spotlight: Stable has won the last two runnings of this maiden; 300,000gns yearling; easy to back at 11-1 for a maiden at the July meeting, she didn't have the clearest of runs in finishing behind Speed Of Sound; should show more.
runners.comment: 11-1 at Newmarket and didn't have the clearest of runs in finishing behind Speed Of Sound

runners.name: Minkaas
runners.spotlight: £140,000 breeze-up 2yo and she was only a short-head behind Jaan Ki Tukri, who ran quite well to be ninth in the Coventry, when third at Bath (5f, good to firm); that debut run was in May so she's been out for a while, but interesting otherwise.
runners.comment: £140,000 breeze-up 2yo and plenty of positives to take from her third at Bath in May

runners.name: Babzini
runners.spotlight: Kept on for third on debut at Salisbury (5f, good to firm) in May and didn't enjoy run of the race when below that form at Goodwood 19 days later; those races were won by useful types and this filly is bred to be suited by this move up in trip.
runners.comment: Beaten in races won by useful types and bred to be suited by this move up in trip

runners.name: Lady Of Hay
runners.spotlight: Well related; 11-2 at Newbury (6f, good to firm) where she faded out of it to be about 5l off the winner; needs more and a hood is soon turned to.
runners.comment: Needs to step up plenty on her Newbury effort and hood is soon turned to

runners.name: Lilywhite Hart
runners.spotlight: Showed plenty more second time out at Newbury when just ahead of Lady Of Hay; unlikely that a repeat of that will be good enough to trouble the best of these.
runners.comment: Showed plenty more second time out at Newbury when just ahead of Lady Of Hay

runners.name: Pensando A Te
runners.spotlight: Cost 75,000gns as a yearling and a half-sister to three winners, while dam was smart at 6f/7f; has to be of interest kicking off at this level, all the more so if at all strong in the market.
runners.comment: Cost 75,000gns as a yearling and a half-sister to three winners; has to be of interest

runners.name: Ava Louise
runners.spotlight: Has performed to an ordinary level in her first two races over shorter; one for another day.
runners.comment: Performed to an ordinary level in her first two races over shorter; one for another day

runners.name: Foxsbrush
runners.spotlight: 1,000gns foal; prominent to a point at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) before trailing home last.
runners.comment: 1,000gns foal; prominent to a point at Newmarket (7f) before trailing home last

runners.name: Divine Concerto
runners.spotlight: 66-1 and trailed home last over 7f at Newmarket in June; opposable.
runners.comment: 66-1 and trailed home last over 7f at Newmarket in June; opposable

races.race_name: Strawberry Fields Stud Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Troublesome Guest
runners.spotlight: Highly tried in two runs after a promising debut but only fifth of the six runners on her nursery debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) where she didn't get the clearest of runs but wasn't unlucky.
runners.comment: Fifth on nursery debut; she didn't get the clearest of runs but wasn't unlucky

runners.name: Dowman
runners.spotlight: Gelded during his two-month absence since justifying favouritism in a 5f novice at Windsor by a length when tried in a tongue-tie for the first time; that wasn't much of a race but he could well improve some more.
runners.comment: Gelded during his two-month absence since justifying favouritism in a 5f novice at Windsor

runners.name: Wait Geordie
runners.spotlight: Beat Dowman on his debut and then ran third in the Lily Agnes; now threatening to go the wrong way as since gelded he's finished last in a nursery and beaten 6l in the Super Sprint.
runners.comment: Career started well but now threatening to go the wrong way

runners.name: Beauty Box
runners.spotlight: The 1-3 favourite when winning a 6f maiden at Ripon (good) before her no show in a Listed race; this mark looks high enough but she's hooded for the first time.
runners.comment: Outclassed latest; this mark looks high enough but she's hooded for the first time

runners.name: Dubai Charm
runners.spotlight: Twice placed before flying too high at Royal Ascot; dropped back to 5f and sent off favourite, she quickened up well to win on nursery debut here four weeks ago; the 7lb rise was hefty enough but still considered.
runners.comment: Off the mark in a C&D nursery; the 7lb rise was hefty enough but still considered

races.race_name: Origin Amenity Solutions Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Liberate
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise when fourth on his debut at Lingfield (1m2f, soft) in June and built on that when third of seven at Ffos Las (1m2f, good) next time; leading claims.
runners.comment: Built on the promise of his debut when third at Ffos Las last time; that sets the standard

runners.name: State Express
runners.spotlight: 35,000gns yearling; colt by Admire Moon; first foal; dam runner-up 7f turf in Japan, half-sister to useful winners Memorial Day (1m-1m4f) and Mutafawwig (6f-1m), out of 1m2f Listed winning half-sister to French Derby winner Anabaa Blue; market should be informative on his debut.
runners.comment: 35,000gns yearling; colt by Admire Moon; dam runner-up 7f turf in Japan; watch the market

runners.name: Time Thief
runners.spotlight: Gelding by Time Test; first foal; dam 1m winner (including AW/Group 2; RPR 113), closely related to 1m5f/1m6f winner Mirrie Dancers, half-sister to Danish 1m1f Listed winner Moomba, out of 1m1f Group 3 winner; his dam won on her debut; interesting.
runners.comment: Out of Group 2 winner Lavender's Blue (won on her debut); interesting newcomer

runners.name: Seigneur
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to 6f winner Waistcoat (RPR 80); always behind after slightly missing the break on his debut at Lingfield (1m, AW; hooded) last month and needs to take a big step forward now stepping up in trip.
runners.comment: Always behind on his debut at Lingfield over 1m last month; big step forward needed
runners.owner: Booth, Silver, Steed And Fittocks Stud

runners.name: Angel Breeze
runners.spotlight: Down the field in two starts on the AW over 1m last November and has since been given wind surgery; tongue-tie is also added on her first start for 252 days and this half-sister to Group-placed 1m2f-1m5f winner Berkshire Breeze may be suited by this longer trip.
runners.comment: Down the field in two starts on the AW in November; has had wind surgery; tongue-tie on

races.race_name: Brandfords Restaurant & Bars Handicap

runners.name: Le Rouge Chinois
runners.spotlight: Only 1-16 on turf and 3-24 on the AW; well handicapped on his best form when previously with Mick Appleby and won over nearly 2m in France earlier this year; absent since April so market support would be welcomed.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on his best form when previously with Mick Appleby; off since April

runners.name: Highland Harvey
runners.spotlight: Belatedly off the mark in a classified race over the extended 1m3f here three weeks ago (good to firm); early days with this yard and could be competitive back in a handicap, despite going up 6lb.
runners.comment: Belatedly off the mark in a classified race over the extended 1m3f here three weeks ago

runners.name: Cloudy Rose
runners.spotlight: An 8yo who hasn't been at her best of late, on slow and fast ground; however, very capable off this sort of mark if staging a revival.
runners.comment: Below best of late but very capable off this sort of mark if staging a revival

runners.name: Spaceage Love Song
runners.spotlight: Beaten just over 2l by Highland Harvery in a classified race here last month and has a 4lb pull on that rival; however, he broke slowly at Nottingham last time in another classified contest and never counted.
runners.comment: Chance on his second here but then broke slowly at Nottingham and never counted
runners.owner: M L W Bell Racing Ltd

runners.name: Fornido
runners.spotlight: Well beaten over 1m3f at Windsor last August and otherwise confined to the AW; a winner on Tapeta (1m6f; 2lb lower) and was running well back in the spring; hard to discount.
runners.comment: Most runs on the AW, winning over 1m6f on Tapeta; running well back in the spring

runners.name: Regally Blonde
runners.spotlight: An infrequent winner but hasn't had a lot of racing since defying an 8lb higher mark over 2m at Ripon last August (good to firm); ran poorly when tried in blinkers once before (usually sports cheekpieces); Saffie Osborne rides but this filly has some questions to answer at present.
runners.comment: Saffie Osborne rides but this filly has some questions to answer at present
runners.owner: Case Racing Partnership & Anita J Lush

runners.name: Urban Warrior
runners.spotlight: A beaten favourite in his last two races, going down by 4l over C&D (soft) and then 6l over 1m4f on the AW; probably has a race in him off this mark given he's still lightly raced and cheekpieces go on.
runners.comment: A beaten favourite in his last two races; lightly raced and cheekpieces now go on
runners.owner: W Enticknap, B Ralph And Partner

races.race_name: Bet Central Classified Stakes

runners.name: Banana
runners.spotlight: Often front-runner; won twice last year, both on ground faster than good, and ran well in a classified event at Chepstow last month on her first start for 246 days; should go well.
runners.comment: Often front-runner who ran well at Chepstow on her first start for 246 days; can go well

runners.name: Charging Bull
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden who went close at Nottingham (5f, soft) in June; respectable effort here over 6f two weeks ago and now drops back in trip with an each-way chance.
runners.comment: 0-13 but went close at Nottingham in June; respectable effort here over 6f last time

runners.name: Cabeza De Llave
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner, mostly recently on AW at Chelmsford in October 2024, who has been placed twice this season; below his best on last two starts but drops into a classified with claims.
runners.comment: Below his best on his last two starts but drops into a classified with claims

runners.name: Mayflower Rock
runners.spotlight: Best effort from four starts came when fourth of 12 in a novice at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in May; well beaten here over 7f on her handicap debut last month but she could be suited by this drop to 5f.
runners.comment: 0-4; well beaten here over 7f on her handicap debut but the drop to 5f could well help

runners.name: Pure Passion
runners.spotlight: 3yo filly who ran to a similar level in two 5f AW starts in January; raced too freely at Southwell (7f, AW) last time on her first start for six months but the drop back in trip looks a positive on her turf debut.
runners.comment: Raced too freely over 7f at Southwell last time; drops back to 5f for her turf debut
runners.owner: J W Parry And Mrs C Shekells

runners.name: She Went Whoosh
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 37 starts came on the AW at Lingfield (5f) last April; runner-up at Bath (5.7f, good to firm) in May but she's struggled in four starts since; stablemate of Banana.
runners.comment: 1-37 and she's struggled since finishing runner-up at Bath in May; best watched

runners.name: Shining Guest
runners.spotlight: Well held on her first three starts and she beat only one rival home in a classified event here over 6f in June; drops in trip with better needed.
runners.comment: Beat only one rival home in a 6f classified event here in June; now drops in trip

runners.name: Chiedozie
runners.spotlight: 27-race maiden who has failed to beat a rival home in each of his last three starts, most recently at Newmarket five days ago; visor returns but he has plenty to prove.
runners.comment: 0-27 and has failed to beat a rival in each of his last three starts; plenty to prove

races.race_name: A P Smithwick Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Grade 1) (Turf)

runners.name: St James The Great
runners.owner: Serio Racing Stables, USA Steeplechase Et Al
